[{"id": "Rku9wP6_1L", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcdaStudy Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "iOuCpruuL_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Study module holds the Bible and your sermons. Staff and members read the Bible in the app, the pastor keeps each sermon with its notes, slides and recording, and members memorize Scripture in the member portal. Published sermons appear on your website, and in a podcast when they have audio.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "j82rloVnI2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Managers add and change sermons, series, handouts and Bible translations. Church Staff can read them. Each member keeps their own Bible Memory list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "dmeMmgh5o7", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Study workspace has a shortcut to the Bible, a count of your sermons and a chart of sermons by month. The sidebar lists Bible, Sermons, Sermon Series, Sermon Handouts, Bible Memory Items and the Bible Memory report. Bible Translations is in the Setup folder.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OA5P5qi8Mb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To turn off the whole Study module, untick it in Church Features. This also takes the sermon pages, the podcast, the Bible on the website and the Bible Memory page off the website and the member portal.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ygCN9fErQA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcd6Bible Reader", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8oz7fXrYsX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Bible page shows the Bible one chapter at a time. Choose a translation, a book and a chapter at the top of the page, and click Next or Previous to turn the page. Each chapter has its own address, so you can bookmark it or send the link to a colleague. The desk Bible page is for staff.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vuU8TMN-nT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The reader opens in your church's Default Bible Translation, set on the Settings tab of the Church form. A branch church with no default of its own uses the default of its parent church. The bulletin and the sermon slides also use this translation unless you choose another one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-OQflwqWN7", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Members and visitors read the Bible on the website at /bible, and members also reach it from the member portal. Visitors who are not signed in see only the free translations. Signed-in members also see the translations that your church imported.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Ut-B8WPjOA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\ude1aTranslations", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0YXHMYv2SW", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Bible Translation holds the whole text of one translation of the Bible, such as the KJV. Every Bible reference in the app is read in a translation: in the Bible reader, on bulletins, on Scripture slides and in Bible Memory. Church Managers add and change translations.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4nChRvvP29", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Churchit comes with common English translations:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "F9q-xRo8rU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The BSB (Berean Standard Bible) downloads its text when Churchit is installed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "IucFCdylA8", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The other free translations (the KJV, WEB, ASV, BBE and Douay-Rheims) download their text the first time someone opens them. The first opening can take a little longer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "FaQNNM3i8V", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Translations that are not free, such as the NIV or the ESV, show the status No Text until your church imports its own licensed copy.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8JeRKY9UHl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A translation is ready to read when its Status is Ready. A translation that is still Downloading, or whose download Failed, is not offered to readers. If a translation cannot open, the reader shows another one with a short notice. A Ready translation has a Read button that opens it in the reader.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aFi9hC6NXd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add a free translation", "col": 12}}, {"id": "zLeRv0UJbZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Bible Translations and click Add Bible Translation.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "QRGAkmUysP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Type the Abbreviation, such as WEB. This short name shows everywhere in the app.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ejmSYTij6v", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Choose Free Use Bible API as the Text Source, and type the translation's id from the Free Use Bible API list, such as BSB or eng_kjv.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tTsySaSea7", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. Save. The text downloads by itself within a minute or two, and the Status changes from Downloading to Ready. Churchit fills in the language and the website of the translation if they are empty.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4750V57Kxb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "If the download fails, check the id and click Download Again. On a free translation that has no text yet, click Download to get the text now.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aKJ-DJdE_a", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Import a translation that your church has a license for", "col": 12}}, {"id": "T1sYcw4y5A", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "For a translation that is under copyright, such as the NIV, ESV or NLT, your church must have a license to use it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "e4iRkKq_i6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Prepare a CSV file with the columns book, chapter, verse and text, one verse to a row.
2. Add a Bible Translation, choose User Import as the Text Source and attach the file as a private file. Churchit refuses a public file and a file with no verses.
3. Save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TbtYlHe8dS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "An imported translation is shown only to people who are signed in, never to website visitors. On a public page, such as a published sermon, a passage in an imported translation shows only its reference.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "NnFxkAeVEC", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: Your church has a license for the ESV. You import it from a CSV file and set it as the Default Bible Translation. Members read the ESV in the member portal and on the bulletin. A visitor who opens your website's Bible reader sees a free translation instead.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DCoUUld5PS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udd16Bible References", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wFoIWrx36D", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Wherever Churchit asks for a Bible reference, type it the way you would write it, such as John 3:16, rom 8:28-30 or Psalm 23. Separate several passages with a semicolon: Romans 3:23; Ephesians 2:8-9. As you type, the desk suggests passages.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w976cr3N06", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "You type references for the Church Verse on the Church form, the Verse of the Week on a Bulletin, the Bible References of a Belief, the Scripture of a Sermon and of its slides, and Bible Memory passages.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HkKcdyRRu-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you save, Churchit writes the reference out in full, such as Romans 8:28-30, and keeps the passages in the order you typed them. A reference that Churchit cannot read is refused, so check the book name and the chapter and verse numbers. Only the 66 books of the Bible are supported, so books such as Tobit are refused.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "EVfR-XS2Jv", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcddSermons", "col": 12}}, {"id": "FRFEpWmCHz", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Sermon keeps one sermon: its title, date, Scripture passage and preacher, the notes, the recording and the video, and the slides that you show while you preach. When you tick Publish, the sermon gets its own page on your website. If it has audio, it also goes into the podcast.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6Gs9H-vnwo", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: On Sunday Pastor Tom preaches on Psalm 23. On Monday the office adds a Sermon with the title The Lord Is My Shepherd, the Sermon Date, the Scripture Psalm 23 and the notes. They attach the audio, paste the YouTube link and tick Publish. The sermon now shows on the website's Sermons page and in podcast apps.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "V5tcNUkYr3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add a sermon", "col": 12}}, {"id": "y3Saa39XdX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Sermons and click Add Sermon.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "lHsY3YPLbS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Type the Title. Two sermons cannot have the same title. To preach a sermon again, add the new date to its Presentation History, or add the year or the series to the new title.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VLJc7hbInb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Fill in the details:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DZhUK5fSPl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Sermon Date: the date when the sermon was first preached. If you leave it empty, Churchit uses the earliest date in Presentation History.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "X-bEswTXEy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Series: the Sermon Series that the sermon belongs to.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-lRAAIbo_y", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Prepared By: the Person who prepared it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-zNVf5sqdq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Scripture: the passage, such as John 3:16-21. Separate passages with a semicolon.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "oH4iaKXtAI", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Notes: the sermon notes or outline. When the sermon is published, the notes are public.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "UYNqT2zK_S", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Transcript: the full text of the sermon, if you have it. It is never published.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "nnkjgsNEzT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Audio Recording and Video Link in the Recording section (see Sermons on the Website).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8iwDkJRrZD", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. Save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TD5sY5x9_y", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Slides", "col": 12}}, {"id": "r6E6N-VHWf", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "On the Slides tab, add a row for each slide that you want to show while you preach. A slide shows either a passage of Scripture or a record of the church:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Es_Ba6K_yr", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A Scripture slide: leave Slide Type empty and type the passage in Scripture, such as Psalm 23. Choose a translation, or leave it blank for your church's default.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "IkROAwrW9Z", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A record slide: choose a Slide Type (Belief, Function, Ministry, Missionary, Person, Sermon Series or Song) and the record. Then choose which fields of the record the slide shows. Tick Title on the field to use as the slide title, and Show Label to print the field's name. Drag the fields to change their order.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jO-1g4XTF8", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "With no fields chosen, the slide shows the name of the record. A Song with no fields chosen shows each part of the song, then a slide with its copyright and CCLI numbers.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w3Y0tEY7VB", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Notes on a slide show on the slide itself, under its content. Everyone who sees the presentation sees them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TjpgO4wwgN", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each slide needs a passage or a record, or the sermon cannot be saved.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HBlUuhcPDP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: Slide 1 is Scripture, Romans 8:28-30. Slide 2 is the Song Amazing Grace with no fields chosen, so its verses and its copyright follow. Slide 3 is the Belief Salvation by Grace, with its title and summary.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "9nM2g5asH5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Present a sermon", "col": 12}}, {"id": "MYFrNFUpOU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Click Present on the sermon form. Churchit saves the sermon first, then opens the presentation in a new tab. Use the arrow keys or the space bar to move between slides. Press Escape or click X to stop.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "crhoudDSOT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A published sermon also has a Present button on the website, so anyone can follow the slides on their own device. Visitors see only the public parts: a published Belief, a published Missionary that is not Sensitive, and a Song with Public Domain ticked. Other slides show \"This slide is not public\". Slide notes show to visitors too.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vqox7d50HX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Presentation History", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-9uwZe3vMQ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Presentation History tab records each time the sermon was preached: the date, who presented it, where, notes and a recording. The website never shows these rows, but a published sermon makes their recordings public (see Sermon Podcast).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "evVY9XVIuc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Study with AI", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AqzukuJpq_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When AI is turned on (see the Foundations manual), a saved sermon has the button Study with AI. It writes study helpers from the notes and the Transcript:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "LbZZ0Y-epq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Discussion Questions: questions for a small group, starting with an easy one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "1WZ6Va9orZ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Summary: three sentences about the sermon.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "oVe9hgGYmg", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Series Description: a short description of the sermon's series. Open Draft opens the Sermon Series with the new description filled in and not saved.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-sm7Nm-oHW", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Handout Blanks: picks key words of the notes. Use puts each one in [square brackets] in the sermon notes. Save the sermon, then click Actions, then Create Handout (see Sermon Handouts). If the sermon has a handout already, change the handout yourself.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "WK0toyxtil", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Devotional and Social Post: for a published sermon only, from the notes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "tAzDm125ox", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Copy puts an answer on the clipboard. The AI does not write a sermon or a prayer. Where Christian traditions differ, the questions show the main views fairly, and the AI adds no teaching that the sermon does not give. Verse text in an answer comes from your church's free default translation, never from the AI. Read each answer against your own teaching.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ybFqAtc8ar", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The notes of a sermon that is not published, and every Transcript, are church records. To send them, the AI model must keep no copy of your data (see the Foundations manual). A person can use Study with AI 20 times an hour.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_F7XG6bHgD", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\u270d\ufe0fSermon Handouts", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qnwNkG8eI1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Sermon Handout is a fill-in-the-blank outline of a sermon for listeners. It prints as the sermon notes insert of the Bulletin of a Function that has the sermon on its schedule. It also shows on the sermon's page on the website.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Nmg9XTXUH4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To make a handout, open the sermon and click Actions, then Create Handout. The handout starts as a copy of the sermon notes, and the sermon's Handout field links to it. A sermon has one handout, so the button shows only while the sermon has none.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "XWH7cJvkD4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Put a word or phrase in square brackets, like [grace], to make it a blank. Listeners see an empty line on paper and an empty box on the website. You still see the words on the handout form, so the form is your answer key. Keep the handout to about half a page, because the bulletin insert has a fixed space.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hE3kQXW1ej", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: The handout says \"While we were still [sinners], Christ died for us.\" The printed bulletin shows \"While we were still ________, Christ died for us.\" On the website, the listener types the missing word in a box.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HYIKuX4fI1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\udf10Sermons on the Website", "col": 12}}, {"id": "H1p5plQDh4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each published sermon has its own page on the website, at /sermon/ followed by its name. Anyone with the link can open it. The Sermons page lists the published sermons, the newest first, 12 at a time. Visitors can search by part of a title or a passage, such as John. The home page shows the newest sermons too.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "l5ziRd4w_g", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The sermon page shows the date, the Scripture passage, the preacher, the series, the video, the audio and the notes. The Sermons page and the home page show only the start of the first paragraph of the notes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "upR9A-aEfK", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Publish a sermon", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-byZHT--nE", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Tick Publish on the sermon and save. Publishing makes these things public:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PFOJOR3m4t", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- the sermon page and the full notes,
- the Audio Recording, and every recording in Presentation History, so that the podcast can play them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4yV0y2OLPW", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you untick Publish, the recordings become private again. Do not publish a sermon whose recordings must stay private.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kRB_2EdwBi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Video Link", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AOC3GyFdak", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Paste an https link to the video of the sermon. A video on Let's Church, YouTube, PeerTube or Owncast plays on the sermon page. Any other link shows as a Watch the video link. A link that does not start with https:// cannot be saved.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "dgc21yX5Cg", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Notes for listeners", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rnmnkbbZvq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When a sermon has a Handout, the sermon page shows the handout as Sermon Notes in place of the notes. The Sermons page and the home page then show no notes for that sermon, because the notes hold the answers. Each word in brackets becomes an empty box. Below the outline is a My Notes box. What a listener types stays in their own browser, and Churchit does not receive it. Print prints only the notes, and Copy copies the filled outline and the notes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AdGlrOT1Zo", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Sermon Series", "col": 12}}, {"id": "M1PWeEzeoY", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A published Sermon Series shows on the Sermons page as one card that lists its sermons, with its description and its Series Image. A sermon in a series that is not published shows on its own card, and its page does not name the series. Attach the Series Image as a public file: untick Private in the upload window. A private image does not show on the website.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OaNONG5Jag", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you rename a sermon", "col": 12}}, {"id": "8zNyP7Ea6w", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When you change the title of a published sermon, the address of its page changes too. Churchit adds a redirect from the old address to the new one, so old links keep working. You find these redirects in Website Settings under Route Redirects.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aYOcZ9MPBd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "With more than one church", "col": 12}}, {"id": "XY9GMCpxtD", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A sermon belongs to its church. Tick Shared with All Churches to show it on the website and in the podcast of every church. The page of a sermon of a church that is not published shows \"Page not found\".", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PTTAdpZBh1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\udfa7Sermon Podcast", "col": 12}}, {"id": "MvRFHr6x5a", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Your website has a podcast feed of your sermons at /podcast.xml. Podcast apps such as Apple Podcasts, Spotify and AntennaPod read this feed. The Sermons page has a Subscribe to the podcast link to it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "uAvKKUkKFG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The feed lists each published sermon that has public audio. When a sermon has no audio of its own, the feed uses the recording of its newest presentation in Presentation History, with the date of that presentation. The feed uses the name, About, Image and Email of the Church. With more than one church, each church has its own feed, and it also lists the sermons shared with all churches.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "IFi5vzCSHa", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Add your podcast to Apple Podcasts or Spotify", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cLVDprfBJ7", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Attach a square image of 1400 to 3000 pixels to the Image of the Church. Apple Podcasts refuses a smaller one.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OhFLft7MU6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Make the image public: in the upload window, clear Private before you click Upload. If the image is already attached, open the File list, open the image by its file name, clear Is Private and save. If the image is private, the feed shows the Churchit icon. If only System Managers can upload public files on your site, ask a System Manager.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ZX5IqgqoRc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. On the Sermons page, copy the address of the Subscribe to the podcast link.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "QGAH44826K", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. Add it in Apple Podcasts Connect or Spotify for Creators.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_3tmnqgYtM", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udde0Bible Memory", "col": 12}}, {"id": "LHRELHNDKf", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Bible Memory helps members learn Scripture by heart, in the member portal. Each member keeps a list of passages. They practice each passage until they can type it without a mistake. Staff can give the same passage to a whole group, for example a weekly memory verse.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "lmTGY9lpJA", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each passage on a member's list is a Bible Memory Item, and each finished practice is a Memory Session.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "FluC_DSKaQ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Memorize a passage in the member portal", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Y439LNX--o", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. In the member portal, open Bible Memory.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VeQIQ2CFla", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Click Add a passage, type the reference, such as John 3:16-18, choose a translation and click Add. Only translations that are ready are offered.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "70tHWlnj_1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Click Practice on the passage. There are two ways to practice:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kXlkFfnI-O", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Blur: read the passage, click Hide more words to blur a few words at a time, and say it aloud. Press and hold Hold to show to see all the words for a moment. Undo and Start again help when you go too far. Done adds 5% to the progress.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GKW7wggc6l", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Type: type the first letter of each word. A run with no mistake adds 50% and counts as a perfect run. A run with one or two mistakes adds 10%. Each wrong letter takes 2% off at once.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "RmCPZZ2123", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The list shows each passage under Learning until its progress reaches 100%. Only Type can take a passage to 100%. Blur stops at 99%. At 100% the passage moves to Memorized. A mistake later takes it back to Learning, so keep practicing.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pg1UhLI5eB", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: Anna adds Psalm 23. On Monday she uses Blur three times to learn it: 15%. On Tuesday she types it with one mistake: 10% more, less 2% for the wrong letter. Over the next week she types it perfectly twice and reaches 100%, so Psalm 23 moves to Memorized.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kztrRMxw0h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A member cannot add the same passage in the same translation twice. Remove takes a passage and its progress off the list, also a passage that a manager assigned.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "sklG2wcpUO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Assign a passage to a group or to people", "col": 12}}, {"id": "H7avIG0PVW", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Managers can put a passage on the lists of many people at once, for example the memory verse of the month for a small group.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OH7sosejJp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Bible Memory Items and click Assign a Passage.
2. Type the passage and choose its translation. You can choose only a translation that you can read.
3. Pick a Group, a User, or both, and click Assign.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "2vWH1rQX2r", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Everyone in the group who has a portal login gets the passage. A dialog lists the people of the group with no portal login. Click a name to open the person, invite them to the portal, then assign the passage again.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "klO9aOw9Z3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A person who is missing from the User list has no portal login yet. Each new passage shows Assigned by the manager, and the group, on the member's list. If the member has the list open, a message says \"A new passage is on your list\". Nothing is emailed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0l8fz77GiJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- If a person already has the passage in that translation, Churchit skips them. Their own item keeps no group.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "9ig26HCB0g", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- You can assign only to people of your own churches.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Op5GnzfMKy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A passage keeps its group when the group is deleted, but then shows no group. You cannot set the group of a passage by hand.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TyJFnvqubn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- In the member portal, a member can choose a group at the top of Bible Memory to see only its passages.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4N3YrUluTM", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example: The youth leader assigns Psalm 23 in the BSB to the Teen Group. Mary has a portal login and gets the passage. David has no login, so the dialog names him.
